title: refactor(app-shell): Studio's Interfaces create dialog picks with the shared Select (objectui#11865)
body:
Part of #11865

Clause-②: no

Studio's Interfaces create dialog (*New page*, *New report*) picked with three browser-native selects. They now use the shared Radix `Select`, the control the card's earlier slices moved Studio's other pickers to (objectui#11934, objectui#11976, objectui#11990, objectui#11995, objectui#12000). This PR converts one source file: `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/interfaceCreate.tsx`.

## What changed

- `PageCreateFields` (the page's source kind) and `ReportCreateFields` (the report's dataset, then one of its measures) pick through one module-private `CreatePicker`, the shape of `SettingsPicker` and `OwdPicker`. Nothing new is exported.
  - Items carry option indexes, so "Choose a dataset…" and "Choose a measure…" (value `''`) need no empty `SelectItem`.
  - A value no option carries gets an item of its own, labelled with the value. Picking it writes nothing.
- Each pick reaches the same `onChange` value the native control's `change` did. The page kind still maps through `picked === 'react' ? 'react' : 'html'`.
- Each picker stays inside its wrapping label element, which names the trigger as it named the native select.
- Trigger size classes: `h-auto px-2 py-1.5 text-sm`, the padding and font the native control had.

## Files

- `interfaceCreate.tsx`: the conversion.
- `interfaceCreate.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx`: the new pin.
- Three suites drove the native controls with `change` events and `.value` reads. They now pick through the primitive, and each shown-value read compares the trigger's whole text:
  - `interfaceCreate.test.tsx`;
  - `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesCreate-11823.test.tsx`;
  - `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesCreatePage-11823.test.tsx`.
- The two `StudioDesignSurface.*` files are test suites in the same folder that mount this form through the Interfaces pillar. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` itself (PR objectui#11982, another seat) is untouched.
- `.changeset/11865-interface-create-shared-select.md`: a patch for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Readings against the dispatch hypotheses

- **H1, value parity: holds.** A scratch probe on base `b1f0dcc00` drove each native select with a `change` event for every option, using the new pin's fixtures. Every row the pin compares as JSON text is the value the probe read there:
  - page kind: HTML gives `"html"`, React gives `"react"`;
  - dataset: "Choose a dataset…" gives `{"dataset":"","measure":""}`, and a dataset gives `{"dataset":"orders_ds","measure":""}`;
  - measure: "Choose a measure…" gives `{"dataset":"orders_ds","measure":""}`, and a measure gives `{"dataset":"orders_ds","measure":"revenue"}`.
  - The probe's `change` event also fired for the current option, which a browser's native select does not do. So the re-pick rows ("writes nothing") pin the primitive.
- **H2, names, keyboard and read-only.**
  - Names: the probe read "Written in", "Dataset" and "Measure" on base. The head reads the same names; that is the one pin that is green against the native control too, by design.
  - Keyboard: Enter opens the measure picker, and Enter on an option selects it. Pinned.
  - Read-only: the form has no such state. A read-only package offers no create entry, so the dialog never opens there. The pillar suites' tests "a read-only package shows no create entry" and "a read-only package shows no New menu" pin that, unchanged.
- **H3, a value outside the options: shown.** The native control showed its first option for such a value, read on base:
  - "Choose a dataset…" for an unlisted dataset;
  - "Choose a measure…" for an unlisted measure, a binding that `isReportBindingComplete` accepts and Save would write;
  - "HTML" for `react` where react pages are turned off.
  The trigger now shows the value itself. All three cases are pinned.
- **H4, first-load bytes: neutral.**
  - Before the first edit, on base: `interfaceCreate.tsx` ships in the lazy `studioBuilder` chunk, which is not among the 336 members of `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`. The eager closure was 3,391,276 B gzip, under the 3,391,484 B ceiling.
  - On head `d91697bd7`: the eager closure is 3,391,276 B gzip and 11,495,616 B raw. That is a delta of 0 B both ways against base, with no eager chunk changed.
  - `studioBuilder` grows by 19 B raw and 64 B gzip.
  - Local `pnpm check:eager-closure` prints "Console eager closure is 3311.8 KB gzipped across 336 of 2458 chunks (budget: 3312.0 KB, headroom: 0.2 KB)".

## Evidence (head `d91697bd7`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run` from the repo root, under the container's verify lock: the four create-form suites plus `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/column-identity.ratchet.test.ts` and `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`. Result: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 82 passed (82)`.
- Reverse leg, run from the committed head:
  - `interfaceCreate.tsx` was put back on base's blob, proven by hash on disk (3 native selects, 0 `CreatePicker`), and the new pin was run: `Tests 24 failed | 1 passed (25)`. The one that passed is the name pin.
  - The file was restored with `git checkout HEAD`, proven by blob hash, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), run after building the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure (28 of 28 turbo tasks): exit 0. `--listFilesOnly` on the test tsconfig lists all four touched suites.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the five touched source and test files: 0 errors and 8 warnings. All 8 are `react-refresh/only-export-components` on `interfaceCreate.tsx`'s existing exports, and base's blob gives the same 8.
- Gates, each exit 0:
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`;
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)"), `pnpm check:control-bytes`;
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`;
  - `check:i18n-keys`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:phantom-deps`.

## Docs

No guide or README names these three controls, so the docs-driven rule has nothing to update.

## Acceptance notes

- One display change, described in the changeset: a value none of a picker's options carries now shows as itself (H3).
- The card stays open: the other native selects on it are not touched here.
